name: void-touched
lore_descriptor: hard to look at: the eye slides off it and refuses to focus
first_pickup_chronicle: Void-touched. I don't want to write this down. Nothing stops it, not even Abaddon. It cuts angels. I know what side holding this puts me on.
design_notes: Chain combat v2 tuning: damage_mult 1.55, weight_mult 0.80, effective_against aberration+void_spawn (T5 elemental). Abaddon-adjacent ONLY. weight defies physics. The abaddon_resistance_bypass is HUGE — bypasses Abaddon's 5-of-6 resistances. anti_heaven means it damages celestials too. The 'dark ending' material.
